description: Upload a local file to S3 as a Dagster asset -- mirrors Airflow's LocalFilesystemToS3Operator / S3Hook.load_file.

local_path.label: Local Path
local_path.description: Path (relative to the Dagster process working directory) to the local file to upload.

dest_s3_url.label: Dest S3 Url
dest_s3_url.description: Destination object as 's3://bucket/key'. Set this or bucket+key.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: Destination bucket name. Set with key, or use dest_s3_url instead.

key.label: Key
key.description: Destination object key. Set with bucket, or use dest_s3_url instead.

replace.label: Replace
replace.description: False (default, matches S3Hook.load_file): fail clearly if the destination key already exists, checked via head_object before uploading. True: always upload, overwriting any existing object.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered aws_s3_resource. When set, credentials/session come from that resource instead of a bare boto3.client('s3', region_name=...).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

name: S3UploadFileAsset
